glossary.definition: (1) "Electronic technology" means electronic technology acceptable to the tax commissioner under division (B) of this section.
glossary.source_title: Section 5747.082 - Use of electronic filing by tax preparers.

glossary.definition: (2) "Original tax return" means any report, return, or other tax document required to be filed under this chapter for the purpose of reporting the taxes due under, and withholdings required by, this chapter. "Original tax return" does not include an amended return or any declaration or form required by or filed in connection with section 5747.09 of the Revised Code.
glossary.source_title: Section 5747.082 - Use of electronic filing by tax preparers.

glossary.definition: (3) "Related member" has the same meaning as in section 5733.042 of the Revised Code.
glossary.source_title: Section 5747.082 - Use of electronic filing by tax preparers.
